snippet.title: Pegs of Hell – Official Gameplay Trailer | Roguelike Peg-Builder
snippet.description:
Build the board. Break the rules. Descend through Hell.

Pegs of Hell is a pixel-art roguelike peg-builder where every run turns a simple pachinko board into an increasingly ridiculous combo engine.

Build powerful synergies between pegs, cards, characters and mysterious Seals, manipulate the board, trigger devastating chain reactions and discover combinations capable of completely changing the rules of a run.

Inspired by the build-crafting depth of games like Balatro, the satisfying peg gameplay of Peglin, and the combo-engine madness of Ballionaire, Pegs of Hell takes the formula into a devilish casino where you must descend through the seven rings of Hell.

Every run gives you new opportunities to build something completely different. Stack effects. Create absurd combos. Take risks. Break the game before Hell breaks you.

KEY FEATURES

• Roguelike peg-based gameplay
• Deep build-crafting and synergy system
• Cards, characters, pegs and Seals that interact with each other
• Build and transform your board throughout a run
• Discover powerful rule-breaking combinations
• Seven rings of Hell to descend through
• Distinct bosses and characters
• High replayability and multiple build strategies
• Crisp pixel-art presentation

Wishlist Pegs of Hell on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5073610/Pegs_of_Hell/

If you enjoy games where finding the right combination can turn a normal run into something completely broken, add Pegs of Hell to your Steam wishlist.

There are countless ways to build the board.
The question is: how will you break it?
